jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist (commercial) to join our team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical (vocational, such as apprenticeship) or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of administrative\/business experience in tendering activities, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali nel settore elettrico, tra cui la generazione di energia, la trasmissione e la distribuzione, si affidano alle nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia di boccole ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando uno specialista Tender e Quotation (commerciale) per unirsi al nostro team nella nostra fabbrica di boccole MICAFIL in Svizzera. In questo ruolo, sarete parte di un team internazionale che si concentra sulla traduzione delle esigenze e delle sfide dei clienti in offerte e citazioni competitive. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le nostre vendite e altri team interni per garantire che offriamo le migliori soluzioni per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Se siete appassionati di preparare offerte e offerte e volete contribuire attivamente, unisciti al nostro team! Analizzare la richiesta di quotazioni (RFQ) e altri documenti d'appalto per comprendere i requisiti del cliente, l'ambito di lavoro e le specifiche tecniche con allineamento con il team di vendita Collaborare con le attività di vendita, ingegneria, legale e altri dipartimenti interni per raccogliere informazioni necessarie, dettagli tecnici e stime dei costi per le presentazioni di gara Sviluppare documenti di gara e di quotazione completi e ben strutturati, tra cui proposte tecniche, disegni, offerte commerciali e documentazione di supporto Proattivamente mantenere la comunicazione chiara e strutturata con i clienti e le squadre interne durante il processo di aggiudicazione Il vostro background tecnico (professionale, come l'apprendistato) o lo sfondo dell'istruzione commerciale Minimo di 3 anni di esperienza amministrativa\/commerciale nelle attività di aggiudicazione, preparazione delle quote e calcolo dei prezzi, o coordinamento delle offerte, supporto delle vendite interne, o gestione del progetto all'interno di un ambiente industriale o eccellente

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist ein weltweiter Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Namhafte internationale Unternehmen in der Elektroindustrie – einschließlich Stromerzeugung, -übertragung und -verteilung – vertrauen unseren Lösungen. Wir sind weltweit führend in der Hochspannungsdurchführungstechnik. Um unsere Aktivitäten zu stärken, suchen wir einen Tender and Quotation Specialist (kommerziell), der unser Team in unserer MICAFIL-Buchsenfabrik in der Schweiz unterstützt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Teams sein, das sich darauf konzentriert, Kundenbedürfnisse und -herausforderungen in wettbewerbsfähige Angebote und Angebote zu übersetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Vertrieb und anderen internen Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die besten Lösungen anbieten, um die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden auf der ganzen Welt zu erfüllen. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für die Vorbereitung von Ausschreibungen und Geboten interessieren und aktiv beitragen möchten, treten Sie unserem Team bei! Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen analysieren Anfrage für Angebote (RFQs) und andere Ausschreibungsdokumente, um Kundenanforderungen, Arbeitsumfang und technische Spezifikationen in Übereinstimmung mit dem Verkaufsteam Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Technik, Recht und anderen internen Abteilungen, um notwendige Informationen, technische Details und Kostenschätzungen für Ausschreibungsanträge zu sammeln Entwickeln Sie umfassende und gut strukturierte Ausschreibungs- und Angebotsdokumente, einschließlich technischer Vorschläge, Zeichnungen, kommerzieller Angebote und unterstützender Dokumentation Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Einreichungen korrekt, vollständig sind und die angegebenen Fristen und Einreichungsprotokolle einhalten Können Sie an Pre-Bid-Meetings teilnehmen, Kundenklärungen und Verhandlungen wie erforderlich Pflegen Sie eine systematische Aufzeichnung aller Ausschreibungsaktivitäten, Einreichungen und Ergebnisse, für Angebote und Bestell-Checklisten Vorbereitung und Übergabe Kontinuierlich verbessern Ausschreibungsprozesse und Dokumentationsvorlagen, um Effizienz und Qualität zu verbessern Koordination mit internen Stakeholdern für optimale Lösungen. Proaktiv pflegen Sie eine klare und strukturierte Kommunikation mit Kunden und den internen Teams während des gesamten Ausschreibungsprozesses Ihren Hintergrund Technische (berufliche, z. B. Lehrlingsausbildung) oder kaufmännische Ausbildung Mindestens 3 Jahre administrative / geschäftliche Erfahrung in Ausschreibungsaktivitäten, Angebotsvorbereitung und Preiskalkulation oder Gebotskoordination, interne Verkaufsunterstützung oder Projektmanagement in einem industriellen oder technischen Umfeld Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Formulierung genauer Gebote und Angebote Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) und Erfahrung mit Ausschreibungsmanagement-Software oder CRM-Systemen Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen, mit scharfer Aufmerksamkeit für Details und lösungsorientierter Ansatz Fluency in Englisch ist erforderlich; Kenntnisse in Deutsch und anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est un leader technologique mondial dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. Des entreprises internationales renommées dans l'industrie électrique – y compris la production, le transport et la distribution d'électricité – font confiance à nos solutions. Nous détenons une position de leader mondial dans la technologie de douille haute tension. Pour renforcer nos activités, nous recherchons un spécialiste de l'appel d'offres et de la cotation (commercial) pour rejoindre notre équipe à notre usine de douilles MICAFIL en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie d'une équipe internationale qui se concentrera sur la traduction des besoins et des défis des clients en offres et en devis concurrentiels. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos ventes et d'autres équipes internes pour vous assurer que nous offrons les meilleures solutions pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients partout dans le monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la préparation des appels d'offres et que vous voulez contribuer activement, rejoignez notre équipe ! Comment vous ferez une analyse d'impact Demande de soumissions (QF) et autres documents d'appel d'offres pour comprendre les exigences des clients, l'étendue du travail et les spécifications techniques avec l'alignement avec l'équipe des ventes Collaborer avec les services des ventes, de l'ingénierie, des services juridiques et d'autres ministères internes pour recueillir les renseignements nécessaires, les détails techniques et les estimations des coûts pour les soumissions Élaborer des documents d'appel d'offres complets et bien structurés, y compris des propositions techniques, des dessins, des offres commerciales et de la documentation à l'appui S'assurer que toutes les soumissions sont exactes, complètes et respectent les délais et les protocoles de soumission spécifiés. Maintenir de façon proactive une communication claire et structurée avec les clients et les équipes internes tout au long du processus d'appel d'offres Vos antécédents Technique (professionnel, comme l'apprentissage) ou formation commerciale Expérience minimale de 3 ans d'expérience administrative/d'affaires dans les activités d'appel d'offres, la préparation des devis et le calcul des prix, ou la coordination des soumissions, le soutien interne aux ventes ou la gestion de projet dans un environnement industriel ou technique Expérience éprouvée dans la formulation d'offres et de devis précis Une bonne compréhension des processus d'appel d'offres, des termes contractuels et des aspects commerciaux Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) et expérience avec les logiciels de gestion des soumissions ou les systèmes CRM Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec une attention particulière aux détails et à l'approche axée sur la solution La maîtrise de l'anglais est un atout.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi! Come farete un impatto Assicuratevi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti. Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. Analizzare i dati di processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla propria responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. La tua laurea di primo livello in un campo relativo (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel Ph.D. con esperienza nell'industria Estensiva esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer soprattutto nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione wafer (testa di film, wafer semiconduttore) Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con l'estrazione dei dati, la manipolazione e l'analisi Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione La competenza nella scienza e nella programmazione dei dati è preferita Buon Inglese e Tedesco competenze linguistiche Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Treten Sie einem leistungsstarken Fotolithografie-Team bei, in dem Ihre Expertise wirklich Wirkung zeigt. Als Senior Photolithography Engineer sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Photolithographieprozessen in der Halbleiterfertigung verantwortlich. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, mit fortschrittlichen Lithografiegeräten zu arbeiten, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und qualitativ hochwertige Produktionsstandards zu gewährleisten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, technische Entscheidungen zu gestalten, zu langfristigen Werkzeugstrategien beizutragen und sinnvolle Verbesserungen in Bezug auf Stabilität, Betriebszeit und Prozessleistung voranzutreiben. Sind Sie jemand, der Verantwortung übernimmt, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeiht und es genießt, echte Auswirkungen zu erzielen? Heute bewerben! Wie Sie einen Einfluss erzielen Sicherstellen, dass Prozesse das Produktionsprogramm und die Ertragsziele erfüllen und alle Produkterträge und Nacharbeitsprobleme angehen. Engagieren Sie sich mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialanbietern, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. Entwickeln Sie neue Techniken, ändern Sie bestehende Designs und koordinieren Sie Prozessverbesserungsprojekte. Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu erkennen, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (Implementieren und regelmäßige Überprüfung von SPC). Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzen, Diffusion, Metallen, Trockenätzen und Implantatteams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten. Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, z. B. um CD und Overlay zu messen. Bereitschaftsdienste an Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie ab der Produktion erforderlich) mit Teilnahme an der Bereitschaftssitzung (vor dem Bereitschaftsdienst) in eigener Verantwortung mit den anderen Bereitschaftsdienstanbietern vereinbart. Ihr Hintergrund-Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrik, Mechanik, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Wafer-Photolithographie-Operationen insbesondere in Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Fertigungsumgebung (Dünnfilmkopf, Halbleiterwaferherstellung) Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Wafer-Fabrik-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Erfahrung mit Datenextraktion, -manipulation und -analyse Ein starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie Die Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. En tant qu'ingénieur principal en photolithographie, vous serez responsable du développement et de l'optimisation des processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. C'est l'occasion pour vous d'élaborer des décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'apporter des améliorations significatives à la stabilité, à la disponibilité et au rendement des processus. Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Comment vous ferez un impact Assurez-vous que les processus répondent aux objectifs du programme de production et de rendement et qu'ils traitent de tout problème de rendement et de retravail. Mobiliser les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. Analyser les données de processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'écharpe humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'écharpe sèche et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. Prend en charge certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire mesurer CD et Overlay. Les services de garde le week-end et les jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec la participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres fournisseurs de services de garde. Votre formation Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou Ph.D. avec expérience de l'industrie Expérience étendue dans les opérations de photolithographie de wafer, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition à Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication de wafer (fin-film, fabrication de wafer semi-conducteur) Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données Une bonne compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion La compétence en data science et en programmation est préférée Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Operator Anlagenbetreuer/in Prüflabor 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In dieser Funktion erwartet dich eine herausfordernde und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, bei der du als technisch versierter Allrounder mit Weitblick unser Hochleistungslabor verstärken. Zusammen mit unseren Prüfingenieuren führst du Versuche mit Leistungsschaltern durch. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und stellst sicher, dass der Betrieb reibungslos verläuft, unsere Prüfanlage mit Kurzschlussgenerator technisch einwandfrei funktioniert und agierst aktiv bei Störfällen. Das kannst du bewirken Einrichtung der Prüfanlage für den Betrieb Vorbereitung und Aufbau von Messungen und Versuchen Bedienung des Kurzschlussgenerators sowie andere für die Versuche erforderlichen Steuereinrichtungen und Messinstrumente Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs der Anlage im operativen Prüfbetrieb Instandhalten, Erweitern und Erneuern von elektrischen und mechanischen Anlagen im Hochleistungslabor Unterstützung bei Wartungsarbeiten und notwendigen Revisionen an der Anlage (Hilfsschalter, Generator, etc.) Erstellung von Dokumentationen zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten und Revisionen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Fachausbildung in einem elektrotechnischen Beruf Fundierte Kenntnisse im sicheren Umgang mit Elektrizität Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Anlagen und\/oder Kraftwerken Gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Idealerweise Kenntnisse in der elektrische Anlagentechnik im Prüflaborbetrieb, sowie in Leittechnik, Messtechnik, Steuerungstechnik Erfahrung im Umgang mit Hubarbeitsbühnen und Hallenkranen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

titleByLocale.fr: Opérateur Laboratoire d'essais d'entretien des installations 80 - 100% (h/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it: In questo ruolo, ci si può aspettare un compito impegnativo e variegato, in cui, come all-rounder tecnicamente esperto con la vista, rafforzare il nostro laboratorio ad alte prestazioni. Insieme ai nostri tecnici di prova, effettuerete test con interruttori di circuito. Siete la persona di contatto centrale e assicuratevi che l'operazione funzioni senza intoppi, il nostro sistema di prova con generatore di cortocircuito funziona tecnicamente impeccabile e agisce attivamente in caso di guasti. Questo può essere ottenuto impostando il sistema di prova per l'operazione Preparazione e installazione di misurazioni e test Funzionamento del generatore di cortocircuito, nonché altri dispositivi di controllo e strumenti di misura necessari per i test Assicurare un funzionamento regolare del sistema durante il funzionamento di test operativo Manutenzione, estensione e rinnovo di sistemi elettrici e meccanici nel laboratorio ad alte prestazioni Supporto durante il lavoro di manutenzione e ispezioni necessarie del sistema (interruttore ausiliario, generatore, ecc.) Preparazione della documentazione sui lavori effettuati e revisioni Questo vi porterà con una formazione specialistica completa in una professione elettrotecnica conoscenza del suono nella gestione sicura dell'esperienza di lavoro dell'elettricità nella manutenzione di impianti e / o impianti di energia Buone competenze tedesche, inglese competenze di vantaggio Idealmente nella tecnologia di impianti elettrici nel funzionamento di laboratorio di prova, così come nella tecnologia di controllo, tecnologia di misura, esperienza di tecnologia di controllo nella gestione delle piattaforme di lavoro di sollevamento e gru di portata di vantaggio
descriptionByLocale.en: In this role, you can expect a challenging and varied task, in which you, as a technically-savvy all-rounder with foresight, strengthen our high-performance laboratory. Together with our test engineers, you will carry out tests with circuit breakers. You are the central contact person and ensure that the operation runs smoothly, our test system with short-circuit generator works technically flawlessly and actively acts in the event of failures. This can be achieved by setting up the test system for the operation Preparation and setup of measurements and tests Operation of the short-circuit generator as well as other control devices and measuring instruments required for the tests Ensuring a smooth operation of the system during the operational test operation Maintenance, extension and renewal of electrical and mechanical systems in the high-performance laboratory Support during maintenance work and necessary inspections of the system (auxiliary switch, generator, etc.) Preparation of documentation on the work carried out and revisions This will bring you with completed specialist training in an electrotechnical profession sound knowledge in the safe handling of electricity work experience in the maintenance of plants and / or power plants Good German skills, English skills of advantage Ideally knowledge in electrical plant technology in test laboratory operation, as well as in control technology, measurement technology, control technology experience in handling lifting work platforms and hall cranes of advantage More about us Our flexible working methods help you to optimize your personal and professional performance, and create an environment in which all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Dans ce rôle, vous pouvez vous attendre à une tâche difficile et variée, dans laquelle vous, en tant qu'expert en prospective technique, renforcer notre laboratoire de haute performance. Avec nos ingénieurs d'essai, vous effectuerez des essais avec des disjoncteurs. Vous êtes la personne de contact centrale et vous assurez que l'opération fonctionne bien, notre système de test avec générateur de court-circuit fonctionne techniquement sans défaut et agit activement en cas de défaillance. Pour ce faire, il est possible de mettre en place le système d'essai pour le fonctionnement Préparation et mise en place des mesures et essais Fonctionnement du générateur de court-circuit ainsi que d'autres dispositifs de commande et instruments de mesure nécessaires pour les essais Assurer le bon fonctionnement du système pendant le fonctionnement de l'essai Maintenance, extension et renouvellement des systèmes électriques et mécaniques dans le laboratoire haute performance Support pendant les travaux d'entretien et les inspections nécessaires du système (interrupteur auxiliaire, générateur, etc.) Établissement de la documentation sur les travaux réalisés et les révisions Vous bénéficierez ainsi d'une formation spécialisée dans une profession électrotechnique et d'une connaissance approfondie de la manipulation sécuritaire de l'expérience de travail en électricité dans l'entretien des installations et/ou des centrales électriques.Bonnes compétences allemandes, compétences anglaises d'avantage Une connaissance optimale de la technologie des centrales électriques dans le fonctionnement des laboratoires d'essais, ainsi que de la technologie de contrôle, de la technologie de mesure, de l'expérience technologique de contrôle dans la manutention des plates-formes de travail de levage et des grues de hall d'avantage.

jobs.title: Monteur/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Als Monteur\/in bist du ein zentraler Teil unserer Fertigung für gasisolierte Hochspannungsschaltanlagen. Mit deiner sorgfältigen und präzisen Arbeitsweise stellst du sicher, dass unsere Produkte gemäss höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards montiert werden. Du arbeitest selbständig nach Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Arbeitsanweisungen und bringst dich aktiv in Verbesserungen der Produktionsprozesse ein. Das kannst du bewirken Montage anspruchsvoller gasisolierter Hochspannungsschaltanlagen gemäss Arbeitsunterlagen, Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Prozessbeschrieben Selbständige Kontrolle der Arbeitsergebnisse sowie Eintrag und Bestätigung in Checklisten Einhalten von Vorgaben bezüglich Ordnung, Sauberkeit, Produktionszeiten sowie Qualitätsstandards Sicherstellen von Umwelt-, Gesundheits- und Arbeitssicherheitsvorgaben im gesamten Montageprozess Erkennen, Melden und Beheben von Montagefehlern und Abweichungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Vorgesetzten Mitwirken am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) durch Einbringen neuer Ideen und Hinweise Unterstützen und Anleiten weniger erfahrener Mitarbeitender bei Montageaufgaben Führen einfacher Produktionsdokumentation zur Sicherstellung der Nachverfolgbarkeit und Analyse Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische oder handwerkliche Ausbildung (z. B. Produktionsmechaniker\/in, Polymechaniker\/in, Anlagen- und Apparatebauer\/in oder vergleichbar) Erfahrung in der Montage von industriellen oder elektrotechnischen Baugruppen, idealerweise im Hochspannungs- oder Anlagenbau Fähigkeit, Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Arbeitsanweisungen sicher zu lesen und umzusetzen Hohe Sorgfalt, Qualitätsbewusstsein und selbständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit und Umweltvorgaben in der Produktion Teamfähig, zuverlässig und bereit, Verantwortung im Montageprozess zu übernehmen Mehr über uns Dich erwartet ein modernes Produktionsumfeld, in dem Präzision, Teamarbeit und Sicherheit an erster Stelle stehen. 
• Wir bieten dir eine gründliche Einarbeitung, vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und die Chance, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Hochspannungsschaltanlagen mitzuwirken.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come assemblatore, sei una parte centrale della nostra produzione per interruttori ad alta tensione isolati a gas. Con il vostro modo di lavorare attento e preciso, assicurate che i nostri prodotti siano assemblati ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza. Lavorate in modo indipendente secondo disegni, liste di parti e istruzioni di lavoro e partecipate attivamente ai miglioramenti dei processi produttivi. Questo può essere ottenuto assemblando sofisticati interruttori ad alta tensione isolati a gas secondo documenti di lavoro, disegni, liste di parti e processiDescritto controllo indipendente dei risultati di lavoro, nonché l'ingresso e la conferma nelle liste di controllo Compliance con le specifiche riguardanti l'ordine, la pulizia, i tempi di produzione e gli standard di qualità. Lo portate con una formazione tecnica o artigianale completa (ad esempio meccanica di produzione, polimeccanica, fabbricante di impianti e apparecchiature o comparabile) nell'assemblaggio di assiemi industriali o elettrotecnici, ideale nella capacità di costruzione di impianti ad alta tensione per leggere e implementare in modo sicuro disegni, liste di parti e istruzioni di lavoro Alta cura, consapevolezza della qualità e metodi di lavoro indipendenti, strutturati.
• Vi offriamo una formazione approfondita, diverse opportunità di sviluppo e la possibilità di partecipare attivamente allo sviluppo ulteriore del nostro switchgear ad alta tensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As an assembler, you are a central part of our production for gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear. With your careful and precise way of working, you ensure that our products are assembled to the highest quality and safety standards. You work independently according to drawings, parts lists and work instructions and actively participate in improvements of the production processes. This can be achieved by assembling sophisticated gas-insulated high-voltage switchgear according to work documents, drawings, parts lists and processesDescribed Independent control of the work results as well as entry and confirmation in checklists Compliance with specifications regarding order, cleanliness, production times as well as quality standards Ensuring environmental, health and safety specifications throughout the assembly process Recognizing, reporting and correcting assembly errors and deviations in cooperation with supervisors Participating in the continuous improvement process (CIP) by introducing new ideas and advice Supporting and guiding less experienced employees in assembly tasks You bring this with completed technical or craft training (e.g. production mechanic, polymechanic, plant and apparatus manufacturer or comparable) experience in the assembly of industrial or electrotechnical assemblies, ideally in high-voltage or plant construction ability to safely read and implement drawings, parts lists and work instructions High care, quality awareness and independent, structured working methods Understanding for occupational safety and environmental requirements in production team-ready, reliable and ready to take responsibility in the assembly process.
• We offer you thorough training, diverse development opportunities and the opportunity to actively participate in the further development of our high-voltage switchgear.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant qu'assembleur, vous êtes un élément central de notre production de commutateurs haute tension à isolation gazeuse. Avec votre façon de travailler soignée et précise, vous assurez que nos produits sont assemblés selon les plus hautes normes de qualité et de sécurité. Vous travaillez indépendamment selon les dessins, les listes de pièces et les instructions de travail et participez activement à l'amélioration des processus de production. Pour ce faire, on peut assembler un commutateur à haute tension à isolation gazeuse sophistiquée selon les documents de travail, les dessins, les listes de pièces et les processus.Décrit Contrôle indépendant des résultats des travaux ainsi que l'entrée et la confirmation dans les listes de contrôle Conformité aux spécifications concernant l'ordre, la propreté, les délais de production et les normes de qualité Assurer les spécifications environnementales, sanitaires et de sécurité tout au long du processus de montage Reconnaître, signaler et corriger les erreurs et les écarts de montage en collaboration avec les superviseurs Participer au processus d'amélioration continue (PIC) en introduisant de nouvelles idées et conseils Soutenir et guider les employés moins expérimentés dans les tâches de montage Vous apportez cette expérience avec une formation technique ou artisanale complète (par exemple, mécanicien de production, polymécanique, fabricant d'installations et d'appareils ou comparable) dans le montage d'assemblages industriels ou électrotechniques, idéalement dans la capacité de haute tension ou de construction d'usine à lire et à mettre en œuvre en toute sécurité des dessins, des listes de pièces et des instructions de travail.
• Nous vous offrons une formation approfondie, diverses possibilités de développement et la possibilité de participer activement au développement de notre commutateur haute tension.

jobs.title: Production Planner 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Our local Insulation & Components product group is the technical market leader in the design and manufacture of transformer bushings. Customers include well-known, international companies in the electrical industry involved in power generation, power transmission and power distribution. Our high-voltage bushings occupy a top position worldwide. We are currently setting up Sales and Operation Planning at the Altstetten site to be able to plan production and upstream processes efficiently and at an early stage. In addition, the positive working environment and our reliability are to be further promoted. jobs.title: Tendering Sales Specialist – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Tendering Sales Specialist for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland) to join our team and play a key role in supporting commercial activities, customer service excellence and service quotation preparation throughout the entire customer lifecycle. Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process to determine customer specific needs and pricing. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Tendering Sales Specialist it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are customer-focused, highly organized, and thrive in a dynamic technical environment, we would love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Prepare and manage quotations for traction service activities (oil analysis, on-site customer Service interventions, workshop repairs, spare traction transformers and maintenance price catalogs) using MS Office and corresponding pricing calculation templates, ensuring accurate commercial and pricing information in Salesforce and other business systems Act as the primary point of contact for customer requests, proactively following up on quotations, opportunities, and commercial inquiries Coordinating communication and follow-up on cases with internal teams (sales, logistics, purchasing, finance, and technical support) to ensure the creation and processing of service offers Monitoring customer satisfaction and managing issues with escalation if needed.  Providing customer support including sharing information about service offerings, products, and prices based on current standard rates. Maintain customer master data and ensure accurate archiving of commercial documentation across SAP, MDG, SharePoint, and other business systems Collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Logistics, and Finance teams to ensure efficient order execution and an excellent customer experience throughout the spare parts lifecycle Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related discipline First experience in after-sales service, project management, commercial support, sales operations, spare parts administration, or a similar role Good understanding of offer preparation, quotation management, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms, order execution, contract administration, logistics processes, invoicing, and customer support Experience working with SAP, Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Strong customer focus and ability to build effective relationships across cross-functional teams Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, proactive, solution-oriented, and committed to delivering a high-quality customer experience Traveling sometimes within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista di vendita di offerte per la nostra unità di business di servizi di trasformatori di trazione, a Ginevra (Svizzera) per unire il nostro team e svolgere un ruolo chiave nel sostenere le attività commerciali, l'eccellenza del servizio clienti e la preparazione di quotazione di servizio in tutto il ciclo di vita del cliente. Segnalando a Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager supporterai l'organizzazione Vendite e i clienti durante il processo di vendita per determinare le esigenze e i prezzi specifici del cliente. Sarete parte del Team Vendite che si concentra sul Servizio Trasformatore Trazione in Europa. Come Specialista di vendita di offerte è il vostro compito emozionante per facilitare la transizione della mobilità sostenibile da un portafoglio di prodotti ferroviari all'avanguardia e servizio ferroviario per apparecchiature di rolling stock. In questo team, lavorerai con i colleghi internazionali che hanno molti anni di esperienza all'interno del business di servizio del trasformatore di trazione on-board per le apparecchiature di rolling stock. Con sede a Ginevra, il ruolo si assumerà la responsabilità per i clienti ferroviari in Europa (produttori di treni OEM, operatori ferroviari, società di leasing). Se siete orientati al cliente, altamente organizzati, e prosperare in un ambiente tecnico dinamico, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Preparare e gestire le quotazioni per le attività di servizio di trazione (analisi del petrolio, interventi del cliente in loco, riparazioni di workshop, trasformatori di trazione di ricambio e cataloghi dei prezzi di manutenzione) utilizzando MS Office e corrispondenti modelli di calcolo dei prezzi, garantendo informazioni commerciali e prezzi accurate in Salesforce e altri sistemi di business Act come punto primario di contatto per le richieste dei clienti, proattivamente seguendo le quotazioni, le opportunità e le richieste commerciali Fornire assistenza clienti tra cui la condivisione di informazioni sulle offerte di servizio, prodotti e prezzi basati sulle attuali tariffe standard. Mantenere i dati del cliente e garantire l'archiviazione accurata della documentazione commerciale in SAP, MDG, SharePoint e altri sistemi aziendali Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di vendita, ingegneria, gestione del progetto, logistica e finanza per garantire l'esecuzione efficiente dell'ordine e un'eccellente esperienza del cliente in tutto il ciclo di vita dei pezzi di ricambio. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio Forte focus del cliente e la capacità di costruire relazioni efficaci tra i team interfunzionali Altamente organizzato con un'attenzione eccellente ai dettagli e la capacità di gestire più priorità simultaneamente, proattiva, orientata alla soluzione, e impegnata a fornire un'esperienza di cliente di alta qualità Viaggiare a volte all'interno dell'Unione Europea, se necessario. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous recherchons un spécialiste des ventes d'appels d'offres pour notre unité de service Transformateurs de traction, à Genève (Suisse), pour rejoindre notre équipe et jouer un rôle clé dans le soutien des activités commerciales, l'excellence du service à la clientèle et la préparation des devis de service tout au long du cycle de vie de la clientèle. Relevant du Service de Traction Sales and Marketing Manager, vous soutiendrez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente pour déterminer les besoins spécifiques du client et les prix. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe des ventes qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que spécialiste des ventes d'appels d'offres, vous avez la tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires et de services ferroviaires de pointe pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes axé sur le client, hautement organisé, et prospère dans un environnement technique dynamique, nous aimerions entendre de vous. Comment vous ferez un impact Préparer et gérer les devis pour les activités de service de traction (analyse pétrolière, interventions de service à la clientèle sur place, réparations d'atelier, transformateurs de traction de rechange et catalogues de prix de maintenance) en utilisant MS Office et les modèles de calcul des prix correspondants, en assurant l'exactitude des renseignements commerciaux et des prix dans Salesforce et d'autres systèmes commerciaux Act comme point de contact principal pour les demandes des clients, en suivant de façon proactive les devis, les possibilités et les demandes de renseignements commerciaux Coordonner la communication et le suivi des dossiers avec les équipes internes (ventes, logistique, achats, finances et soutien technique) afin d'assurer la création et le traitement des offres de service. Fournir un soutien à la clientèle, y compris le partage d'information sur les offres de services, les produits et les prix en fonction des tarifs standard actuels. jobs.description:
The Opportunity Join our dynamic team in Klingnau, where we specialize in world-class, high-precision plastics manufacturing. As a key player in sectors such as energy, rail, aerospace, industrial services, and more, we pride ourselves on delivering tailored, reliable, and innovative solutions to our global customers. Our success is driven by a collaborative team culture, streamlined decision-making, and a strong focus on automation and process optimization. We're constantly evolving to meet the demands of a fast-paced market—and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us. If you're passionate about production planning and want to be involved in the entire value chain, from customer inquiry to final delivery, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Analyze customer inquiries and calculate cost estimates Prepare and maintain detailed work instructions Create and manage production documentation Monitor material flow and ensure availability Maintain accurate master data in SAP S4HANA Collaborate closely with production, sales, procurement, engineering, and logistics Drive continuous improvement in planning and production processes Your background Technical expertise in a relevant field (e.g., polymechanic, industrial mechanic, mold maker, carpenter) Several years of experience in a similar role, ideally in planning or manufacturing Strong technical drawing and bill of materials interpretation skills Proficient in SAP and Microsoft Office tools Independent, detail-oriented, and a strong team player Fluent in German, with good command of English More about us Our flexible working models help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees are empowered and can thrive. Über die Position Werden Sie Teil unseres dynamischen Teams in Klingnau, das sich auf die hochpräzise Kunststoffverarbeitung auf Weltklasseniveau spezialisiert hat. Als wichtiger Akteur in Branchen wie Energie, Bahn, Luft- und Raumfahrt, industrielle Dienstleistungen und mehr, sind wir stolz darauf, massgeschneiderte, zuverlässige und innovative Lösungen für unsere globalen Kunden zu liefern. Unser Erfolg basiert auf einer kollaborativen Teamkultur, schlanken Entscheidungswegen und einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierung und Prozessoptimierung. Wir entwickeln uns ständig weiter, um den 
• Anforderungen eines schnelllebigen Marktes gerecht zu werden – und suchen jemanden, der mit uns wachsen möchte. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Produktionsplanung haben und in die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – von der Kundenanfrage bis zur Auslieferung – eingebunden sein möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Das können Sie bewirken Analyse von Kundenanfragen und Erstellung von Kalkulationen Erstellung und Pflege detaillierter Arbeitsanweisungen Erstellung und Verwaltung von Produktionsunterlagen Überwachung des Materialflusses und Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit Pflege von Stammdaten in SAP S4HANA Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Vertrieb, Einkauf, Engineering und Logistik Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Planungs- und Produktionsprozesse Das bringen Sie mit Technische Ausbildung in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Polymechaniker, Industriemechaniker, Werkzeugmacher, Schreiner) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion, idealerweise in der Planung oder Fertigung Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Lesen technischer Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Sicherer Umgang mit SAP und Microsoft Office Selbstständige, detailorientierte Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden befähigt sind und sich entfalten können.

In this role, you will work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and site organizations to ensure that quality requirements are understood, implemented, and continuously improved.  You will act as a trusted quality partner to the Project Manager, helping the team achieve project objectives, manage risks, and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction. jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. You can achieve this by carrying out installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and correction of complex electrical equipment and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each deployment. Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options. training of customer staff in the handling of the facilities. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automatist) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy engineering). Several years of professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry. In-depth knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is advantageous. Safe use of measuring and test equipment. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills. High degree of initiative, responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driving licence category B. Willingness to work flexible hours and travel. More about us
• We offer exciting and varied
• Tasks with great creative leeway as well as attractive further education and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and diverse activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and food packages as well as a say in the choice of accommodation.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato con l'attenzione su Automazione e Robotica per ottimizzare e migliorare l'efficienza delle nostre linee di produzione Interruttore Isolato Gas (GIS). Questo ruolo comporta l'applicazione di principi di ingegneria industriale, tecnologie di automazione e soluzioni robotiche per migliorare i processi produttivi, ridurre i rifiuti e migliorare la produttività. I laureati motivati con una forte attenzione all'automazione e alla robotica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare. Analizzare i layout delle linee di produzione GIS attuali, i flussi di lavoro e le procedure operative per identificare le aree per il miglioramento dell'efficienza, dei costi e della qualità, con un focus sul potenziale di automazione Design e implementare processi di produzione ottimizzati, tra cui nuove metodologie, concetti di automazione, applicazioni robotiche, utilizzo delle attrezzature e flusso dei materiali. Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni di lavoro per l'assemblaggio e il test GIS, compresi i processi automatizzati e assistiti da robot Collaborare con altri ingegneri industriali, responsabili di produzione, ingegneri di progettazione, qualità e nuovo team di implementazione del prodotto Piombo e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, tra cui Lean Manufacturing e Six Sigma, sfruttando le tecnologie di digitalizzazione e automazione Forte sfondo nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, principi di produzione magra e metodologie di miglioramento continuo (ad esempio, Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficienza negli strumenti di analisi dei processi (ad esempio, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo, controllo dei processi statistici) Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e gestire più progetti simultaneamente Familiarity con i processi produttivi GIS o simili attrezzature elettriche complesse è altamente auspicabile Fluente aziendale in inglese e tedesco Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Operational Procurement Team Leader - 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Lead and manage a team of procurement professionals to ensure efficient and effective operational procurement activities, supporting HITACHI ENERGY business objectives and supply chain optimization. How you'll make an impact Manage and mentor a team of procurement specialists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment. Oversee the end-to-end operational procurement process, including requisitioning, purchase order creation, expediting, and invoice resolution. Develop and implement procurement strategies to optimize delivery performance for assigned categories. Monitor key procurement metrics, analyze performance data, and identify areas for improvement. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineering, manufacturing, logistics, finance, planning ) to understand their needs and ensure timely and effective supply. Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures. Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function, leveraging best practices and technology. Resolve complex supplier issues effectively and efficiently. Your background Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in procurement, ideally with 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role. Proven experience in operational procurement within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of procurement best practices and supplier relationship management. Proficiency in SAP Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Certifications such as CIPS (Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply) or equivalent are a plus. English on negotiation level, German should be B1 More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'occasion Diriger et gérer une équipe de professionnels de l'approvisionnement pour assurer des activités d'approvisionnement opérationnelles efficaces et efficientes, en appuyant les objectifs commerciaux de HITACHI ENERGY et l'optimisation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Comment vous aurez un impact Gérer et encadrer une équipe de spécialistes de l'approvisionnement, favorisant un environnement collaboratif et performant. Superviser le processus d'approvisionnement opérationnel de bout en bout, y compris la demande, la création de bons de commande, l'accélération et le règlement des factures. Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'approvisionnement pour optimiser le rendement de la prestation pour les catégories attribuées. Surveiller les principales mesures d'approvisionnement, analyser les données sur le rendement et déterminer les domaines à améliorer. Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes (p. ex., l'ingénierie, la fabrication, la logistique, les finances, la planification) afin de comprendre leurs besoins et d'assurer un approvisionnement rapide et efficace. Veiller au respect de toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise. Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein de la fonction d'approvisionnement, en tirant parti des pratiques exemplaires et de la technologie. Résoudre les problèmes complexes des fournisseurs de façon efficace et efficiente. Votre formation Baccalauréat en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, en administration des affaires, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe. Minimum de 5-7 ans d'expérience dans l'approvisionnement, idéalement avec 2 ans dans un rôle de leadership ou de supervision. Expérience éprouvée en matière d'approvisionnement opérationnel dans un environnement industriel ou manufacturier. Meilleure compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en matière d'approvisionnement et gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs. jobs.title: R&D Test System Integration Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join the Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg. You will play a key role in developing, integrating, and commissioning advanced electrical test systems used for the characterization, validation, and qualification of power semiconductor devices and modules. In this role, you will design, integrate, and commission electrical test solutions while collaborating with experts across R&D, laboratories, and external partners. To strengthen our laboratory and test infrastructure capabilities, we are looking for a highly motivated engineer who enjoys combining system thinking with hands-on engineering. This role offers broad exposure to power electronics, laboratory infrastructure, and product qualification activities. You will continuously expand your technical expertise while contributing to innovative technologies for renewable energy, transportation, industrial applications, and HVDC systems. How you'll make an impact   Develop and integrate electrical test systems for power semiconductor characterization and evaluation Lead the design of solutions for high-power testing applications Commission, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory test equipment Collaborate with R&D teams to support product development and validation Integrate measurement systems, sensors, power supplies, and automation solutions Define system requirements and coordinate activities with external partners Investigate equipment failures and support root cause analysis activities Create technical documentation, specifications, and test procedures Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field Experience in system engineering, hardware integration, or test engineering Solid understanding of power electronics and electrical measurement systems Hands-on experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and laboratory equipment Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical drawings Strong communication skills and fluency in English More About Us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out.   Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. The Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional is responsible for driving the standardization, optimization, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes across HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers global operations. This role involves defining best practices, developing new process technologies, and implementing robust solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness. How you'll make an impact: Define, document, and standardize manufacturing processes globally, ensuring consistency and adherence to best practices as well as making sure these are globally transferred to support capacity expansion projects. Lead and support process improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4.0 principles to optimize manufacturing operations. Identify opportunities for process automation, digital transformation, and the integration of advanced manufacturing technologies. Collaborate with R&D, engineering, production, quality teams and especially with our Global Platform Leaders to ensure seamless new product introductions and process validations&Develop and deliver training programs to manufacturing personnel on new processes, technologies, and improvement methodologies. Conduct process audits and performance analyses to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. Benchmark internal and external manufacturing processes to identify industry best practices and innovative solutions. Manage complex process improvement & capacity expansion projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline management, and stakeholder communication. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations, and internal quality management systems&Provide expert technical support and guidance to manufacturing sites worldwide on process-related issues. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field). Master's degree preferred. Strong experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, or continuous improvement roles within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully leading and implementing significant manufacturing process improvements and transfer of technology projects. Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification highly desirable) & Experience with advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and digital manufacturing solutions (e.g., MES, SCADA, AI\/ML in manufacturing). Proficiency in process simulation software, CAD\/CAM tools, and statistical analysis software. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required (up to 30-50%). Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo sta avanzando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Portiamo il potere nelle nostre case, scuole, ospedali e fabbriche. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale per le nostre comunità e la società. Porta la tua passione, porta la tua energia e fai parte di un team globale che apprezza una semplice verità: diversità + collaborazione = grande innovazione. Il Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional è responsabile per la guida della standardizzazione, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo dei processi produttivi nelle operazioni globali di HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers. Questo ruolo consiste nella definizione delle migliori pratiche, nello sviluppo di nuove tecnologie di processo e nell'implementazione di soluzioni robuste per migliorare l'efficienza, la qualità e l'efficacia dei costi. Come farete un impatto: Definire, documentare e standardizzare i processi produttivi a livello globale, assicurando coerenza e aderenza alle migliori pratiche e assicurando che questi siano trasferiti a livello globale per sostenere i progetti di espansione della capacità. Iniziative di miglioramento del processo di piombo e di supporto, utilizzando metodologie come i principi Lean, Six Sigma e Industry 4.0 per ottimizzare le operazioni di produzione. Identificare le opportunità per l'automazione dei processi, la trasformazione digitale e l'integrazione delle tecnologie di produzione avanzate. Collabora con R&D, ingegneria, produzione, team di qualità e soprattutto con i nostri Global Platform Leaders per garantire nuove introduzioni di prodotto e validazioni di processo&Sviluppare e fornire programmi di formazione al personale di produzione su nuovi processi, tecnologie e metodologie di miglioramento. Condurre audit di processo e analisi delle prestazioni per identificare strozzature, inefficienze e aree di miglioramento. Benchmark processi produttivi interni ed esterni per identificare le best practice del settore e le soluzioni innovative. Gestisci progetti complessi di miglioramento del processo e di espansione della capacità, tra cui la definizione di ambito, l'allocazione delle risorse, la gestione della timeline e la comunicazione degli stakeholder. Garantire la conformità con gli standard, le normative e i sistemi di gestione della qualità interna e fornire un supporto tecnico esperto e una guida ai siti di produzione in tutto il mondo su questioni legate al processo. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative esterne e interne applicabili, procedure e linee guida. La tua laurea di primo livello in Ingegneria (meccanica, elettrica, industriale, manifatturiera o campo correlato). Preferito il master. Una forte esperienza nell'ingegneria manifatturiera, nello sviluppo di processi o in ruoli di miglioramento continuo all'interno di un ambiente di produzione globale. Provato record di successo di leader e l'implementazione di significativi miglioramenti del processo di produzione e trasferimento di progetti tecnologici. Forte conoscenza dei principi di produzione magra, metodologie Six Sigma (Green Belt o Black Belt certificazione altamente auspicabile) & Esperienza con tecnologie di produzione avanzate, automazione e soluzioni di produzione digitale (ad esempio, MES, SCADA, AI\//ML nella produzione). La competenza nel software di simulazione di processo, strumenti CAD\/CAM e software di analisi statistica. Eccellente gestione del progetto, analitica, problem solving, decision-making, comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di gestire più progetti complessi contemporaneamente e influenzare efficacemente gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi. Capacità di viaggiare a livello internazionale come richiesto (fino al 30-50%). È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; la competenza in altre lingue è un vantaggio.
