Vogliamo che tu prosperi veramente con noi, nel lavoro e fuori.
descriptionByLocale.en: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. The Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional is responsible for driving the standardization, optimization, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes across HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers global operations. This role involves defining best practices, developing new process technologies, and implementing robust solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness. How you'll make an impact: Define, document, and standardize manufacturing processes globally, ensuring consistency and adherence to best practices as well as making sure these are globally transferred to support capacity expansion projects. Lead and support process improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4.0 principles to optimize manufacturing operations. Identify opportunities for process automation, digital transformation, and the integration of advanced manufacturing technologies. Collaborate with R&D, engineering, production, quality teams and especially with our Global Platform Leaders to ensure seamless new product introductions and process validations&Develop and deliver training programs to manufacturing personnel on new processes, technologies, and improvement methodologies. Conduct process audits and performance analyses to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. Benchmark internal and external manufacturing processes to identify industry best practices and innovative solutions. Manage complex process improvement & capacity expansion projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline management, and stakeholder communication. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations, and internal quality management systems&Provide expert technical support and guidance to manufacturing sites worldwide on process-related issues. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field). Master's degree preferred. Strong experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, or continuous improvement roles within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully leading and implementing significant manufacturing process improvements and transfer of technology projects. Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification highly desirable) & Experience with advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and digital manufacturing solutions (e.g., MES, SCADA, AI\/ML in manufacturing). Proficiency in process simulation software, CAD\/CAM tools, and statistical analysis software. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required (up to 30-50%). Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
descriptionByLocale.de: Bei Hitachi Energy ist es unser Ziel, eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle voranzutreiben. Wir bringen Energie in unsere Häuser, Schulen, Krankenhäuser und Fabriken. Begleiten Sie uns und arbeiten Sie mit fantastischen Menschen zusammen, während Sie lernen und sich an Projekten entwickeln, die einen echten Einfluss auf unsere Gemeinschaften und die Gesellschaft haben. Bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft ein, bringen Sie Ihre Energie ein und werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das eine einfache Wahrheit zu schätzen weiß: Vielfalt + Zusammenarbeit = Große Innovation. Der Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional ist dafür verantwortlich, die Standardisierung, Optimierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Fertigungsprozesse in den globalen Geschäftsbereichen von HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle umfasst die Definition von Best Practices, die Entwicklung neuer Prozesstechnologien und die Implementierung robuster Lösungen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit. Wie Sie etwas bewirken: Definieren, dokumentieren und standardisieren Sie Fertigungsprozesse weltweit, stellen Sie Konsistenz und Einhaltung von Best Practices sicher und stellen Sie sicher, dass diese global übertragen werden, um Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte zu unterstützen. Leiten und unterstützen Sie Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen mit Methoden wie Lean, Six Sigma und Industrie 4.0-Prinzipien zur Optimierung des Fertigungsbetriebs. Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Prozessautomatisierung, digitale Transformation und die Integration fortschrittlicher Fertigungstechnologien. Arbeiten Sie mit F & E, Engineering, Produktion, Qualitätsteams und insbesondere mit unseren globalen Plattformführern zusammen, um nahtlose neue Produkteinführungen und Prozessvalidierungen zu gewährleisten und Schulungsprogramme für das Fertigungspersonal zu neuen Prozessen, Technologien und Verbesserungsmethoden bereitzustellen. Durchführung von Prozessaudits und Leistungsanalysen, um Engpässe, Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsbereiche zu identifizieren. Benchmarking interner und externer Fertigungsprozesse, um Best Practices und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren. Verwalten Sie komplexe Prozessverbesserungs- und Kapazitätserweiterungsprojekte, einschließlich Umfangsdefinition, Ressourcenzuweisung, Zeitmanagement und Stakeholderkommunikation. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung relevanter Industriestandards, -vorschriften und interner Qualitätsmanagementsysteme und Bereitstellung fachkundiger technischer Unterstützung und Anleitung für Fertigungsstandorte weltweit zu prozessbezogenen Fragen. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing oder verwandten Bereich). Master-Abschluss bevorzugt. Starke Erfahrung in der Fertigungstechnik, Prozessentwicklung oder kontinuierliche Verbesserung Rollen in einer globalen Fertigungsumgebung. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der erfolgreichen Leitung und Umsetzung bedeutender Verbesserungen des Herstellungsprozesses und des Transfers von Technologieprojekten. Starkes Wissen über Lean-Fertigungsprinzipien, Six-Sigma-Methoden (Green Belt- oder Black Belt-Zertifizierung sehr wünschenswert) und Erfahrung mit fortschrittlichen Fertigungstechnologien, Automatisierung und digitalen Fertigungslösungen (z. B. MES, SCADA, AI / ML in der Fertigung). Kenntnisse in Prozesssimulationssoftware, CAD\/CAM-Tools und statistischer Analysesoftware. Ausgezeichnetes Projektmanagement, Analyse, Problemlösung, Entscheidungsfindung, Kommunikation, Präsentation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere komplexe Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten und Stakeholder auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen effektiv zu beeinflussen. Möglichkeit, bei Bedarf international zu reisen (bis zu 30-50%). Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Kenntnisse in anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus. Wir sind stolz darauf, eine ganzheitliche Palette von Wettbewerbsvorteilen anzubieten, um Ihr finanzielles, körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden sowie Ihr berufliches Wachstum zu unterstützen. Wir möchten, dass Sie mit uns wirklich gedeihen, in der Arbeit und draußen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy, notre objectif est de faire progresser un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Nous apportons le pouvoir à nos maisons, écoles, hôpitaux et usines. Rejoignez-nous et travaillez avec des gens fantastiques, tout en apprenant et en vous développant sur des projets qui ont un impact réel sur nos communautés et notre société. Apportez votre passion, apportez votre énergie et faites partie d'une équipe mondiale qui apprécie une simple vérité : Diversité + Collaboration = Grande Innovation. Le Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional est responsable de la normalisation, de l'optimisation et de l'amélioration continue des processus de fabrication à travers les opérations mondiales HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers. Ce rôle consiste à définir les pratiques exemplaires, à mettre au point de nouvelles technologies de procédés et à mettre en oeuvre des solutions solides pour améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et la rentabilité. Comment vous allez avoir un impact : Définir, documenter et normaliser les processus de fabrication à l'échelle mondiale, en assurant la cohérence et le respect des meilleures pratiques et en s'assurant qu'elles sont transférées à l'échelle mondiale pour soutenir des projets d'expansion de la capacité. Diriger et appuyer les initiatives d'amélioration des processus, en utilisant des méthodologies telles que les principes Lean, Six Sigma et Industrie 4.0 pour optimiser les opérations de fabrication. Identifier les possibilités d'automatisation des processus, de transformation numérique et d'intégration de technologies de fabrication de pointe. Collaborer avec des équipes de R-D, d'ingénierie, de production, de qualité et particulièrement avec nos dirigeants de plateformes mondiales afin d'assurer des introductions de nouveaux produits et des validations de procédés sans faille. Effectuer des audits de processus et des analyses de rendement afin de cerner les goulets d'étranglement, les inefficacités et les domaines à améliorer. Benchmark procédés de fabrication internes et externes pour identifier les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et des solutions innovantes. Gérer des projets complexes d'amélioration des processus et d'expansion des capacités, y compris la définition de la portée, l'affectation des ressources, la gestion du calendrier et la communication avec les intervenants. Assurer le respect des normes, des règlements et des systèmes internes de gestion de la qualité pertinents de l'industrie et fournir un soutien technique et des conseils spécialisés aux sites de fabrication du monde entier sur les questions liées aux procédés. Responsable de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Votre bagage Baccalauréat en génie (mécanique, électrique, industriel, manufacturier ou domaine connexe). Maîtrise préférée. Forte expérience de l'ingénierie manufacturière, du développement de procédés ou des rôles d'amélioration continue dans un environnement manufacturier mondial. Expérience éprouvée de la direction et de la mise en oeuvre d'importants projets d'amélioration des procédés de fabrication et de transfert de technologie. Forte connaissance des principes de fabrication Lean, des méthodologies Six Sigma (Certification de ceinture verte ou de ceinture noire hautement souhaitable) et de l'expérience avec les technologies de fabrication avancées, l'automatisation et les solutions de fabrication numérique (par exemple, MES, SCADA, AI\/ML dans la fabrication). Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus, des outils CAO\/CAM et des logiciels d'analyse statistique. Excellente gestion de projet, analyse, résolution de problèmes, prise de décisions, communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets complexes et d'influencer efficacement les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Capacité de voyager à l'étranger au besoin (jusqu'à 30 à 50 %). La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; la maîtrise d'autres langues est un plus. Plus sur nous Nous sommes fiers d'offrir une gamme holistique d'avantages concurrentiels pour soutenir votre bien-être financier, physique et mental, ainsi que votre croissance professionnelle. Nous voulons que vous prospérez vraiment avec nous, dans le travail et dehors.

Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with global stakeholders across different regions and functions. jobs.title: Intern - Process Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join the Bipolar Semiconductor Process Engineering team in Lenzburg. The internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of semiconductor manufacturing, quality engineering, and digital transformation.  The primary objective of this assignment is to transform an existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) prototype into a robust production application that can be used daily by operators and engineers on the Bipolar manufacturing line. The solution will become an integral part of the factory's quality management system and support the prevention of defects, process deviations, and customer escapes. The DQC initiative builds on ongoing efforts to digitalize quality checkpoints and process controls within the Bipolar semiconductor fabrication environment.  This is a hands-on assignment with direct exposure to semiconductor manufacturing processes, operator workflows, quality assurance systems, database applications, and continuous improvement activities.  How you'll make an impact  Analyze and enhance the existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) solution to support its transition into daily manufacturing operations  Develop user-friendly software features and workflows that improve quality control, usability, and operational efficiency  Collaborate with operators, engineers, shift leaders, and quality specialists to gather requirements and implement practical solutions  Support the integration of manufacturing process controls and quality checkpoints into digital systems  Analyze process and quality data, identify trends, and contribute to data-driven improvement initiatives  Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and quality-related decision making  Participate in testing, validation, deployment, and user training activities to ensure a successful system rollout  Contribute to technical documentation, work instructions, and continuous improvement efforts that enhance long-term system reliability and performance  Your background  Degree, apprenticeship, relevant training, or practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field  Experience with software development using Python, C#, JavaScript, or similar programming languages  Familiarity with databases, SQL, and data management concepts.   Understanding of data visualization, reporting tools, and analytical methods  Knowledge of software testing, debugging, and quality assurance practices  Interest in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, process automation, and continuous improvement  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on and proactive mindset  Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a manufacturing environment  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Territory Sales & Marketing Manager 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy Insulation and Components portfolio covers a wide range of transformer applications, from the small distribution transformers till the bigger power transformers. Our customers portfolio includes Transformer OEMs, components distributors, utilities as well as services companies. In order to support our operations in Europe, we are looking for an experienced Territory Sales and Marketing Manager who will manage a part of the DACH region, mainly the German market . The role can be based either in Germany or Switzerland . How you will make an impact Will be responsible for Sales and Marketing of full I&C portfolio within allocated countries for 3rd party transformer OEMs. Also accountable for delivering OR budget for all applicable I&C factories, for direct customers and also end-customers Conduct technical trainings for all types of customers Liaise with our I&C factories globally in order that quotations and proper technical support are provided. Manage product customization projects. Liaise with Utilities in order to homologate and have approved I&C portfolio, clarify tender specifications Feed Market Intelligence to I&C factories, to our Global Product Group and to our local product managers Provide a regular forecast on OR per country for the full I&C portfolio Collaborate with Hitachi Energy Sales channels and also 3rd parties on Service projects Create synergies between I&C factories in order to increase sales volumes per project Support all promotional Marketing events in Europe organised by I&C Product line Marketing Your background Degree (Bachelor or Master) in a technical discipline, ideally Electrical or Mechanical engineering plus further qualification in business administration More than 10 years of experience in technical and international sales and marketing, supporting multiple products, customers and countries Market or product knowledge in the field of power transformers or distribution transformers insulation and components is essential Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, customer-focused. Ability to establish and manage long-term customer relationships. Excellent planning and organization skills Sound knowledge of MS Office and CRM, preferably Salesforce Business fluent in German and English, spoken and written, is a must. Any other European language skill is an advantage Be willing to travel for international business trips (up to 40%) More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities 
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

You will collaborate with crossfunctional teams ensuring that Foundation APQP essentials are updated according to novelties and new risks. How you´ll make an impact Coordinate the development of Foundation APQP plan. Lead foundation APQP Plan related meetings, collecting and preparing documentation, being main connection point between QMT, Factories, Global experts and R&D. Participate in Foundation FMEA workshops and s upport HUBs and Factories to use foundation APQP essentials (to be cascaded to local products). Support R&D organization to use foundation APQP essentials for new product developments. Support ToT projects to ensure proper transfer of APQP essentials. Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated . Proactive identification of technology novelties to drive updates in foundation APQP essentials and c ollaborate with GPG Operations to identify global process changes that might affect to foundation APQP essentials ( e.g. from best practices to requirement). Your b ackground Technical degree from the University . 3-5 years of experience with APQP ( preferably in industries like Automotive or Wind). Strong knowledge of APQP processes, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, and MSA methodologies. Experience with Plato is an advatage . Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and facilitate effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders. Fluency in English What w e o ffer Collective agreement and flexible working hours. Health care and wellness allowance. Career opportunities within Hitachi Energ y, locally and globally. Mentor support during onboarding. Training and development programs. A diverse workplace with 70+ nationalities in Sweden. Supplementary parental leave compensation. Access to an Employee Benefit Portal with discounts. Additional language skills are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Als Product Engineer Electrical unterstützen Sie das Management und die Entwicklung des Überspannungsableiter-Produktportfolios während des gesamten Lebenszyklus. Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für einen Nachwuchsingenieur, der sich in einem globalen Industrieumfeld mit Produktmanagement, Produktlebenszyklusmanagement (PLM) und Handelskonformität vertraut machen möchte. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Vertriebs-, Fertigungs-, Qualitäts- und Supply-Chain-Teams tragen Sie dazu bei, dass Produkte die Erwartungen der Kunden, Marktanforderungen und regulatorischen Standards erfüllen und gleichzeitig zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungs- und Innovationsinitiativen beitragen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Unterstützung des Managements und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des Überspannungsableiter-Produktportfolios Unterstützung bei der Übersetzung von Kunden-, Markt- und regulatorischen
• Anforderungen in Produktspezifikationen Beitrag zu Produktentwicklung, Innovationsprojekten und Roadmap-Aktivitäten Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsforschung zur Identifizierung von Chancen und Trends Pflegen Sie technische Produktdokumentation, Produktdaten und Marketingmaterialien Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Unterstützung von Produkteinführungen, Änderungen und Kundenanforderungen Unterstützung von Nachhaltigkeits-, Compliance- und Produktveraltungsmanagementaktivitäten Führen Sie Compliance-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Produktklassifizierungen, Zolldatenpflege und Exportkontrollanforderungen Ihr Hintergrund-Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich Erste Berufserfahrung durch Praktika, Ausbildungen, Graduiertenprogramme oder bis zu 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung Interesse an Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und Lifecycle-Management Leidenschaft für Hochspannungsanwendungen und -produkte sowie deren Engineering-Prinzipien Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen mit Liebe zum Detail Fähigkeit, effektiv sowohl unabhängig als auch im Rahmen eines funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten Eifrigkeit zu lernen und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine proaktive, kundenorientierte Denkweise fließend in Englisch; Grundkenntnisse Deutsch wären ein Gewinn. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant qu'ingénieur en produits électriques, vous soutiendrez la gestion et le développement du portefeuille de produits d'arrêt de surtension tout au long de son cycle de vie. C'est une excellente occasion pour un ingénieur en début de carrière qui veut s'exposer à la gestion des produits, à la gestion du cycle de vie des produits et à la conformité commerciale dans un environnement industriel mondial. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes de l'ingénierie, des ventes, de la fabrication, de la qualité et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurerez que les produits répondent aux attentes des clients, aux exigences du marché et aux normes réglementaires tout en contribuant à des initiatives d'amélioration et d'innovation continues. Contribuez à la mise au point de produits, à des projets d'innovation et à des activités de feuille de route. Mener des recherches sur le marché et les concurrents afin de cerner les possibilités et les tendances. Maintenir la documentation technique sur les produits, les données sur les produits et les matériaux de commercialisation. Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour appuyer les lancements, les changements et les demandes des clients. Soutenir les activités de gestion de la durabilité, de la conformité et de l'obsolescence des produits. Diriger les activités de conformité commerciale, y compris les classifications de produits, la maintenance des données douanières et les exigences de contrôle des exportations. Votre formation Maîtrise en génie électrique ou un domaine technique connexe Expérience professionnelle initiale par le biais de stages, d'apprentissages, de programmes d'études supérieures ou jusqu'à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente Intérêt dans la gestion de produits, le développement de produits et la gestion du cycle de vie Passion pour les applications et les produits à haute tension, ainsi que leurs principes d'ingénierie Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes avec une attention particulière au détail Capacité de travailler efficacement à la fois de façon indépendante et dans le cadre d'une équipe interfonctionnelle. Des compétences linguistiques supplémentaires sont un avantage Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer -Diffusion, 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity    Join Hitachi, Ltd. as an Equipment Engineer and play a key role in optimizing and maintaining manufacturing equipment to ensure high performance, reliability, and efficiency. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to continuous improvement and supporting innovative manufacturing processes.  As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the availability, efficiency, and continuous improvement of semiconductor high temperature production systems. This role focuses on the Corrective and Preventive maintenance and optimization of Diffusion & Cleaning equipment while working closely with cross-functional teams to enhance safety, productivity, and system reliability. How you'll make an impact  Develop and implement modifications and upgrades to existing manufacturing equipment to improve efficiency, yield, and safety  Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of complex manufacturing machinery and systems  Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and implement preventive measures  Collaborate with production, R&D, and quality teams to resolve equipment-related issues and optimize processes  Create and maintain documentation for equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and technical specifications  Train technicians and operators on new equipment and updated procedures  Manage spare parts inventory and ensure timely procurement of required components and ensure compliance with safety standards and environmental regulations  Support the selection, installation, and qualification of new manufacturing equipment  Your background  Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or electrical Engineering  Minimum 2 years of experience in equipment engineering within a manufacturing environment  Experience in the Semiconductor field is a must Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and control systems  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, and pneumatics; experience with Diffusion Semiconductor systems (e.g., ASM, Centrotherm furnaces) Proven ability to troubleshoot complex machinery and identify root causes of failures  Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methods  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills  Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment  English is mandatory, German is beneficial   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating measurable impact on the shop floor? As Continuous Improvement Manager, you will partner with factory and operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities, remove bottlenecks, and implement Lean Six Sigma initiatives across the value chain. This is a highly visible role where you will coach teams, lead transformational projects, and help shape a culture of continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations. How you'll make an impact Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement advisor and sparring partner for Factory Managers, Operations Managers, and leadership teams, driving data-driven analyses, optimization initiatives, and operational excellence programs Work across the entire value chain to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, improve flow, and maximize overall business performance Maintain a strong shop-floor presence through regular Gemba activities, working side-by-side with operators, supervisors, and managers to identify opportunities, solve problems, and sustain improvements where value is created Drive and promote Kaizen Events and Rapid Improvement Workshops to accelerate problem-solving, eliminate waste, and deliver fast, sustainable results Train, coach, and mentor employees and leaders in Lean Six Sigma methodologies, supporting certification programs and building continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to map, analyze, redesign, and optimize end-to-end business processes Lead the deployment of Lean principles, standardization, best practices, and benchmarking activities across manufacturing sites Monitor, track, and communicate improvement program results through KPIs, ensuring sustainable implementation and measurable business impact Travel regularly to support factories, conduct workshops, coach teams, and drive improvement initiatives across the organization (minimum 20% travel required) Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical field Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Process Engineering, with proven hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. Factory experience is mandatory Strong understanding and practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt required, Black Belt preferred) Proven experience leading Kaizen Events, Gemba activities, process mapping, value stream analysis, root cause analysis, and change management initiatives Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, and improve end-to-end value stream performance Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills, with experience delivering workshops and Lean Six Sigma certification programs Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working on the shop floor alongside production teams to deliver sustainable improvements Willingness to travel regularly to support factories and improvement initiatives across the region (minimum 20% travel required) Fluent in English; German or Swedish is considered an advantage More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Internal HSE Assessment Program Lead - BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity BU Transformers is looking for a motivated HSE Assessment Program Lead. In this role, you will be leading the HSE Assessment Program that will help on BU compliance with BUTR HSE Instructions and BU operational audits performed by Quality, Engineering, R&D and bring the right guidance, with trained and competent HSE professionals. Finally, you will monitor the BUTR performance regarding the 3LoD Model, follow up, monitor effective corrective actions implementation and close out. You will provide expert guidance on internal HSE Assessment as well. This position requires solid background on setting up and rolling out internal HSE Assessment Programs, based on ISO Norms, excellent communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. The Program Lead will play a pivotal role in completing the cycle of BUTR strategic HSE development. As we advance our HSE Programs rollout to strengthen Culture and Performance, this position will support the BUTR HSE Function to develop the capability to monitor and verify the HSE Programs effective implementation across our HUBs, Units and BU Functions. This role will also reinforce actions aligned with the Three Lines of Defense model and enhance our ability to close gaps identified during Global HSE internal audits. By doing so, the HSE Assessment Program Lead will support the rollout of the BU HSE Strategy, supporting cultural transformation and performance improvement as we expand capacity and meet rising operational expectations and targets. As a global role it is required to travel internationally up to 30% of the time. How you'll make an impact Create the BUTR Internal HSE Assessment Program, roll it out across the BU and create the network to support the assessment process complete, supporting and guiding until improvements are effectively implemented. Ensure compliance assessments and inspections are conducted across operational areas and contractor activities, with accurate reporting of findings and timely corrective actions. Contribute to assess and improve BUTR HSE Management Systems. Support other Programs in a transversal way, integrating the Internal HSE Assessment Program output on improvements and learnings for other BU HSE Programs. Ensure a practical and pragmatic approach on problem solving, remaining very close to BUTR Units, creating easy and effective understanding on demands after assessments and support attitude. Your background University degree (Bachelor or Master) in Occupational Health and Safety, HSE or related field 8+ years' experience in HSE roles Proven experience in auditing, risk assessment, management systems, process improvement, MOC and incident investigation.  Ability to influence stakeholders and drive cultural change.​​​​ Fluent in English. Other languages would be an advantage for candidates. Trained and experienced on ISO 19011, 45001, 14001. Experience on ISO 50001 and 9001, will be convenient. Competent on international HSE legislation.

jobs.title: Operating Unit Engineering Manager for Substation Automation Systems, HUB Europe
jobs.description: The Opportunity We are looking for an Engineering Manager within the Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In this role, you will provide the professional engineering resources required for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of systems delivered through commercial projects under the responsibility of the Operating Unit. You will drive operational and execution excellence through effective engineering management while fostering collaboration across the engineering community within the Operating Unit's countries to share solutions, balance workloads, and leverage lessons learned. Key responsibilities include: Allocating the right engineering resources to project teams in accordance with S&OP processes. Establishing efficient interfaces between engineering teams and OPCs while increasing OPC utilization. Managing customer relationships with respect to technical requirements. In this role, you will report to the Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe . How You'll Make an Impact Lead the engineering teams and own the performance management of engineering deliverables across the Operating Unit in Europe. Serve as the Business Process Owner for engineering and testing processes. Mentor and develop engineering function leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, as well as internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate the implementation of and adherence to global engineering processes, standards, practices, procedures, tools, and digitalization initiatives in collaboration with the Global Product Group and other Operating Units across the Business Unit. Define and lead the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tools, aligned with Business Unit and Global Product Group strategies. Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to ensure operational excellence and strategic alignment. Participate in the budgeting process together with the Operating Unit Manager and Controller. Ensure that the area of responsibility is structured to support the business model, adequately staffed with skilled resources, and effectively managed. Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect reports in accordance with HR policies. Oversee competency assessments and ensure engineering personnel hold the appropriate licenses and certifications. Champion Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, and quality by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related field. More than 15 years of engineering experience in the energy sector, including at least 5 years in a global leadership role. A results-oriented leader with a strong passion for people development, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration. An excellent communicator with the ability to influence beyond your direct organizational responsibilities and think strategically. Experience working within a multinational corporation and a global engineering environment. Strong knowledge of energy systems, grid infrastructure, renewable technologies, and regulatory frameworks within the utility and\/or industrial infrastructure project business, combined with a solid understanding of engineering principles and a proven track record of delivering complex engineering projects across multiple geographies.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un responsabile dell'ingegneria all'interno dell'unità operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In questo ruolo, fornirete le risorse ingegneristiche professionali necessarie per la progettazione, l'ingegneria, il test e la messa in servizio di sistemi consegnati attraverso progetti commerciali sotto la responsabilità dell'Unità Operativa. Potrai guidare l'eccellenza operativa e l'esecuzione attraverso un'efficace gestione dell'ingegneria, promuovendo la collaborazione tra la comunità ingegneristica all'interno dei paesi dell'Unità Operativa per condividere soluzioni, carichi di lavoro di equilibrio e le lezioni di leva imparate. Le responsabilità chiave includono: Alllocation delle risorse ingegneristiche giuste per progettare i team in conformità con i processi S&OP. Stabilire interfacce efficienti tra team di ingegneria e OPC, aumentando l'utilizzo di OPC. Gestione dei rapporti con i clienti rispetto alle esigenze tecniche. In questo ruolo, si segnala al Manager Unità Operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . Come farete un impatto guidare i team di ingegneria e possedere la gestione delle prestazioni dei materiali di ingegneria in tutta l'unità operativa in Europa. Servire come proprietario del processo aziendale per i processi di ingegneria e test. Mentore e sviluppo di leader di funzioni ingegneristiche e membri del team, promuovendo una cultura di innovazione, collaborazione e eccellenza. Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti chiave, così come gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Coordinare l'implementazione e l'adesione a processi di ingegneria globale, standard, pratiche, procedure, strumenti e iniziative di digitalizzazione in collaborazione con il Global Product Group e altre unità operative in tutta l'unità aziendale. Definire e condurre l'implementazione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso processi e strumenti di ingegneria, allineati con le strategie Business Unit e Global Product Group. Monitorare i KPI e le metriche di performance per garantire l'eccellenza operativa e l'allineamento strategico. Partecipa al processo di budgeting insieme al Responsabile Unità Operativa e al Controller. Assicurarsi che l'area di responsabilità sia strutturata per sostenere il modello aziendale, adeguatamente occupata con risorse qualificate e gestita efficacemente. Guidare, motivare e sviluppare rapporti diretti e indiretti secondo le politiche HR. Controllare le valutazioni delle competenze e garantire che il personale di ingegneria detiene le licenze e le certificazioni appropriate. I valori fondamentali di sicurezza, integrità e qualità del campione Hitachi Energy assumendo la responsabilità delle vostre azioni mentre si occupano dei vostri colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea di primo livello o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica, o un campo correlato. Più di 15 anni di esperienza ingegneristica nel settore energetico, tra cui almeno 5 anni in un ruolo di leadership globale. Leader orientato ai risultati con una forte passione per lo sviluppo, la leadership, l'impegno degli stakeholder e la collaborazione. Un eccellente comunicatore con la capacità di influenzare al di là delle vostre responsabilità organizzative dirette e pensare strategicamente. Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di una multinazionale e di un ambiente di ingegneria globale. Forte conoscenza dei sistemi energetici, delle infrastrutture di rete, delle tecnologie rinnovabili e dei quadri normativi all'interno del business del progetto di utilità e\/o infrastruttura industriale, combinati con una solida comprensione dei principi ingegneristici e con un comprovato record di tracciato di fornitura di progetti di ingegneria complessi in più geografie.

Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez les ressources d'ingénierie professionnelle nécessaires pour la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la mise en service de systèmes fournis dans le cadre de projets commerciaux sous la responsabilité de l'unité d'exploitation. Vous favoriserez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'exécution grâce à une gestion de l'ingénierie efficace tout en favorisant la collaboration dans les pays de l'unité opérationnelle afin de partager les solutions, d'équilibrer la charge de travail et de tirer parti des leçons apprises. Les principales responsabilités comprennent : Attribuer les ressources d'ingénierie appropriées aux équipes de projet conformément aux processus S&OP. Établir des interfaces efficaces entre les équipes de génie et les CPVP tout en augmentant l'utilisation du CPVP. Gestion des relations avec les clients en ce qui concerne les exigences techniques. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport au gestionnaire d'unité d'exploitation, Sous-station Automation Systems Europe . Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez les équipes d'ingénierie et possédez la gestion de la performance des produits d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle en Europe. Servir de propriétaire de processus opérationnels pour les processus d'ingénierie et d'essai. Mentor et développer des chefs de fonction en génie et des membres d'équipe, favorisant une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'excellence. Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes. Coordonner la mise en œuvre et le respect des initiatives mondiales d'ingénierie, de normalisation, de pratiques, de procédures, d'outils et de numérisation, en collaboration avec le Groupe mondial des produits et d'autres unités opérationnelles de l'unité opérationnelle. Définir et diriger la mise en œuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration continue à l'échelle des processus et des outils d'ingénierie, conformément aux stratégies de l'unité opérationnelle et du Groupe mondial des produits. Surveiller les ICR et les mesures du rendement pour assurer l'excellence opérationnelle et l'alignement stratégique. Participer au processus de budgétisation en collaboration avec le gestionnaire et contrôleur de l'unité opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que le domaine de responsabilité soit structuré de façon à appuyer le modèle d'entreprise, à ce que le personnel dispose de ressources qualifiées et à ce qu'il soit géré efficacement. Guider, motiver et élaborer des rapports directs et indirects conformément aux politiques des RH. Superviser les évaluations des compétences et s'assurer que le personnel d'ingénierie détient les licences et les certifications appropriées. Les valeurs fondamentales de sécurité, d'intégrité et de qualité du champion Hitachi Energy en prenant la responsabilité de vos actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, en génie énergétique ou dans un domaine connexe. Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en ingénierie dans le secteur de l'énergie, y compris au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leadership mondial. Leader axé sur les résultats, passionné par le développement des personnes, le leadership, l'engagement des intervenants et la collaboration. Un excellent communicateur avec la capacité d'influencer au-delà de vos responsabilités organisationnelles directes et de penser stratégiquement. Expérience de travail au sein d'une société multinationale et d'un environnement d'ingénierie mondial. Forte connaissance des systèmes énergétiques, de l'infrastructure du réseau, des technologies renouvelables et des cadres réglementaires dans le cadre des activités de projets d'infrastructure d'utilité et/ou industrielle, combinée à une solide compréhension des principes d'ingénierie et à une expérience éprouvée de la réalisation de projets d'ingénierie complexes dans plusieurs géographies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch herausfordernde Stelle in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Leitung von multikulturellen Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für das Spannungslevel von 110KV – 550KV Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung der vor Ort Installation, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Einhaltung vertraglicher Termine und unter Berücksichtigung lokaler gesetzlicher Vorgaben Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort ausgeführten Arbeiten mittels Qualitätskontrolle und Beurteilung der Fähigkeiten von lokalen Hilfskräften Durchführen von Produkttraining vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation Verantwortlich für die Evaluierung von Risiken und deren Minimierung. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche

jobs.title: Secondary Design Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. In this role, you will support the execution of secondary engineering deliverables for high-voltage GIS projects, including Local Control Cabinet (LCC) and digital substation applications. You will contribute to engineering documentation across project phases and help deliver high-quality, standard-compliant results while building your expertise in secondary design engineering and tools such as Zuken E3. How you'll make an impact Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline 2–3 years of professional experience in secondary engineering, design engineering, or project engineering is expected Practical experience with engineering tools such as Zuken E3 or comparable ECAD \/ engineering tools is required Basic knowledge of GIS, secondary engineering principles, and applicable standards such as IEC, IEEE, or ANSI is beneficial Structured and reliable way of working, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate across functions and disciplines Fluency in English is required; German and other languages are an advantage More about us Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
• Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di progettazione secondaria per unirsi al nostro team di ingegneria GIS. In questo ruolo, supporterete l'esecuzione dei materiali secondari di ingegneria per progetti GIS ad alta tensione, tra cui Local Control Cabinet (LCC) e applicazioni di sottostazione digitale. Contribuirai alla documentazione ingegneristica in tutte le fasi del progetto e contribuirai a fornire risultati di alta qualità, conformi alla norma, mentre costruirai le tue competenze in ingegneria e strumenti di progettazione secondaria come Zuken E3. Come fare un impatto Preparare gli schemi e i relativi documenti di ingegneria per gli ambiti di ingegneria secondaria GIS, comprese le applicazioni di sottostazione LCC e digitale Supportare l'esecuzione di ingegneria attraverso le fasi di progetto, dalla progettazione di base e la progettazione dei dettagli attraverso la documentazione di fabbricazione e gli aggiornamenti costruiti Creare BOM preliminari, rapporti e documenti di fabbricazione utilizzando strumenti di ingegneria approvati e processi standard Lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale dove innovazione, apprendimento e miglioramento continuo fanno parte del lavoro quotidiano.

In dieser Rolle unterstützen Sie die Ausführung von sekundären technischen Leistungen für Hochspannungs-GIS-Projekte, einschließlich Local Control Cabinet (LCC) und digitalen Umspannwerksanwendungen. Sie tragen zur technischen Dokumentation über die Projektphasen hinweg bei und helfen dabei, qualitativ hochwertige, standardkonforme Ergebnisse zu liefern, während Sie Ihre Expertise in der sekundären Konstruktion und Tools wie Zuken E3 aufbauen. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur de conception secondaire pour rejoindre notre équipe d'ingénierie SIG. Dans ce rôle, vous soutiendrez l'exécution des livrables d'ingénierie secondaire pour les projets SIG à haute tension, y compris le Cabinet de contrôle local (LCC) et les applications de sous-station numérique. Vous contribuerez à la documentation d'ingénierie à travers les phases du projet et vous aiderez à obtenir des résultats de haute qualité et conformes aux normes tout en renforçant votre expertise en ingénierie de conception secondaire et des outils tels que Zuken E3. Comment vous allez faire un impact Préparer des schémas et des documents d'ingénierie connexes pour les champs d'application secondaires du SIG, y compris les applications LCC et les sous-stations numériques Soutenir l'exécution de l'ingénierie au cours des phases de projet, de la conception de base et de la conception de détails par la documentation de fabrication et les mises à jour en cours de fabrication Créer des BOM préliminaires, des rapports et des documents de fabrication à l'aide d'outils d'ingénierie approuvés et de processus normalisés Effectuer des autovérifications structurées et contribuer à l'exécution de produits techniquement corrects, de haute qualité et conformes aux normes.Soutenir les clarifications techniques avec les intervenants internes, les équipes de projet et les usines, et aider à documenter et à fermer les points ouverts Contribuer à l'amélioration continue, à la normalisation et aux meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie, y compris la participation à des communautés d'experts pertinentes Appliquer des lignes directrices internes, des normes d'ingénierie et des exigences de qualité tout en soutenant l'exécution sécuritaire et efficace de projets. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et international où l'innovation, l'apprentissage et l'amélioration continue font partie du travail quotidien.

jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Der Bereich GIS (Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen in der Produktion. Du erkennst Probleme frühzeitig, analysierst sie strukturiert und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen internen Stakeholdern zusammen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse bei. Das kannst du bewirken Du bist die erste Eskalationsstufe für die Produktion und arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen. Verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen (QN) in der Produktion Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Priorisierung von Qualitätsmeldungen (Q-Meldungen) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering, Planung, Projektleitung und Einkauf Du untersützt die Weiterentwicklung von Troubleshooting Prozessen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Unterstützung bei Audits und internen Reviews Das bringst du mit Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Qualität Erfahrung im Troubleshooting, Produktionsprozesse oder in Qualitätsmanagement Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Problemlösungskompetenz Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsfähigkeit Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Kenntnisse in SAP, DPS und MES Detaillierte Produktkenntnisse im Bereich Gas Isolierte Schaltanlagen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

titleByLocale.it: Risoluzione dei problemi Tecnologia di qualità del processo 80 - 100% (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it: L'area di GIS (interruttore isolato a gas) rappresenta la massima qualità, sicurezza ed efficienza, ed è qui che entra il vostro ruolo. In questo ruolo, si assume una funzione centrale nel trattamento e nel coordinamento dei messaggi di qualità nella produzione. Riconoscete i problemi in una fase iniziale, analizzarli in modo strutturato e fornire soluzioni sostenibili. Lavorate a stretto contatto con vari stakeholder interni e contribuite attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri processi. Sei la prima fase di escalation per la produzione e lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni. Responsabile per la creazione e il coordinamento dei rapporti di qualità (QN) nella produzione Assicurare il rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza Una stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti interni come la produzione, la qualità, l'ingegneria, la pianificazione, la gestione dei progetti e l'acquisto. Sostenete l'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi di risoluzione dei problemi per il miglioramento continuo. Questo è ciò che si porta con formazione tecnica nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica, dell'ingegneria meccanica, dell'esperienza di qualità nella risoluzione dei problemi, nei processi produttivi o nella gestione della qualità. Il pensiero analitico, i metodi di lavoro strutturati e le elevate capacità di risoluzione dei problemi. La nostra cultura è caratterizzata da un apprendimento continuo e dall'obiettivo comune di progettare soluzioni energetiche sostenibili. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo in cui ogni opinione conta e puoi contribuire alle tue idee, indipendentemente dall'origine, dal sesso o dallo sfondo.
descriptionByLocale.en: The GIS (gas-insulated switchgear) area stands for the highest quality, safety and efficiency – and this is where your role comes in. In this role, you take on a central function in the processing and coordination of quality messages in production. You recognize problems at an early stage, analyze them in a structured manner and provide sustainable solutions. You work closely with various internal stakeholders and actively contribute to the further development of our processes. You are the first escalation stage for production and work closely with internal stakeholders. Responsible for the creation and coordination of quality reports (QN) in production Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards Prioritization of quality reports (Q notifications) Close cooperation with internal departments such as production, quality, engineering, planning, project management and purchasing You support the further development of troubleshooting processes for continuous improvement Support during audits and internal reviews This is what you bring with technical training in the field of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, quality experience in troubleshooting, production processes or in quality management Analytical thinking, structured working methods and high problem-solving skills Strong communication and decision-making skills Negotiation-proof German and English skills Knowledge in SAP, DPS and MES Detailed product knowledge in the field of gas insulated switchgear More about us At Hitachi Energy we believe in the power of diversity, cooperation and innovation. Our culture is characterized by continuous learning and the common goal of designing sustainable energy solutions. We promote an inclusive working environment where every opinion counts and you can contribute your ideas – regardless of origin, gender or background.

descriptionByLocale.fr: La zone SIG (switchgear à gaz isolé) représente la plus haute qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité – et c'est là que votre rôle entre en jeu. Dans ce rôle, vous assumez une fonction centrale dans le traitement et la coordination des messages de qualité dans la production. Vous reconnaissez les problèmes à un stade précoce, les analysez de manière structurée et fournissez des solutions durables. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec divers intervenants internes et contribuez activement au développement de nos processus. Vous êtes la première étape d'escalade de la production et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes. Responsable de la création et de la coordination des rapports de qualité (QN) en production Assurer le respect des normes de qualité et de sécurité. Coopération étroite avec les services internes tels que la production, la qualité, l'ingénierie, la planification, la gestion de projet et l'achat Vous soutenez le développement des processus de dépannage pour l'amélioration continue Soutien lors des audits et des examens internes C'est ce que vous apportez avec la formation technique dans le domaine de l'ingénierie électrique, mécanique, l'expérience de qualité dans le dépannage, les processus de production ou dans la gestion de la qualité Pensée analytique, méthodes de travail structurées et haute résolution de problèmes Compétences fortes en communication et en prise de décision Compétences en allemand et en anglais à l'épreuve des négociations Connaissances en SAP, DPS et MES Connaissances détaillées des produits dans le domaine des commutateurs isolés au gaz Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, nous croyons en la puissance de la diversité, de la coopération et de l'innovation. Notre culture se caractérise par un apprentissage continu et l'objectif commun de concevoir des solutions énergétiques durables. Nous favorisons un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque opinion compte et vous pouvez contribuer à vos idées, quels que soient l'origine, le sexe ou le contexte.

jobs.title: Project Manager Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager Engineering or Lead Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead and manage converter system projects from sales\/tender phase to initiation and through to completion, ensuring Engineering deliverables are on time, within budget, and in line with quality requirements.  How you'll make an impact  Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in Engineering within defined timelines and budgets   Lead the technical solution development during sales and tender phase for Engineering.  Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in close collaboration with stakeholders   Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth project execution   Communicate project plans, progress, and expectations clearly and proactively   Assess resource requirements and ensure effective allocation throughout the project lifecycle   Track Engineering project milestones, timelines, and deliverables using appropriate tools   Identify technical risks early, manage changes in scope, and implement suitable mitigation measures   Lead, coach, and motivate project team members, fostering accountability and high performance   Conduct project reviews and capture key learnings, deriving actionable recommendations for future improvements  Your background   Master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering   Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution within an engineering environment   Experience with power systems and converter systems is a plus  Proven track record in managing complex engineering projects   PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage   Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills   Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment   Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills   Fluency in English is required; German is a plus  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Product Specialist Transformer Bushings
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Schichtleiter/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position   In dieser verantwortungsvollen und dynamischen Rolle sind Sie für die Produktion während einer Schicht bei MICAFIL in Altstetten (ZH) verantwortlich und stellen sicher, dass wir unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit weiter stärken und unsere Schweizer Niederlassung entwickeln, um dem globalen Marktwachstum gerecht zu werden. Durch Ihre klare Kommunikation und offene Persönlichkeit entwickeln Sie die Teams und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Mit strategischem Weitblick und technischem Know-how unterstützen Sie die Leiter der Produktionsteams und entwickeln nachhaltige Lösungen, welche die Qualität, Effizienz und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit auf die nächste Stufe heben. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft unseres Standortes massgeblich mitzugestalten.  Das können Sie bewirken   Verantwortlich für ein Schichtteam im Produktionsumfeld, einschliesslich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung in einem 3-Schicht-Betriebsmodell (direkte Führung, 10-15 FTE)  Sicherstellung einer kontinuierlichen und hohen Produktionsleistung in enger Abstimmung mit den Fabrikplanern und dem Produktionsleiter  Verantwortung innerhalb der Schicht für Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität   Dokumentation der Schichtleistung und Übergabe an nachfolgende Schichten  Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter in den Produktionsprozess  Identifizierung sowie Integration neuer Technologien und bewährter Verfahren, um den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) gemeinsam mit unserem Process Engineering Team voranzutreiben   Reduzierung des Ausschusses auf ein Minimum  Verbesserung und Schulung von Arbeits- & Wartungsanweisungen zur Sicherstellung des 3-Schicht-Betriebs Überwachung der wichtigsten Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) zur Erfolgsmessung und Rückmeldung an den Produktionsleiter  Das bringen Sie mit   Technische Ausbildung und Weiterbildung (TS \/ HF) im Bereich Technik, Führung oder einem vergleichbaren Gebiet  Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Produktion, idealerweise im Schichtbetrieb  Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lean Management, Six Sigma und anderen Methoden der Prozessoptimierung  Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und datengestütztes Vorgehen bei der Entscheidungsfindung  Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Zeitmanagement, Kommunikation und Organisation sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Termine einzuhalten  Fliessend in Deutsch, Englisch ist von Vorteil  Mehr über uns     Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit Eigenverantwortung Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo responsabile e dinamico, sarete responsabili di uno spostamento di produzione presso MICAFIL ad Altstetten (ZH), assicurandoci di continuare a rafforzare la nostra competitività e sviluppare la nostra filiale svizzera per soddisfare la crescita del mercato globale. Attraverso la vostra chiara comunicazione e la personalità aperta, sviluppate continuamente i team e i processi. Con la supervisione strategica e il know-how tecnico, supporterete i leader del team di produzione e svilupperete soluzioni sostenibili che assumono qualità, efficienza e competitività al livello successivo. Se avete una passione per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, vi offriamo la possibilità di modellare significativamente il futuro della nostra posizione. Questo può causare di essere responsabile per un team di turni nell'ambiente di produzione, tra cui la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team in un modello operativo a 3 turni (gestione diretta, 10-15 FTE) Garantire un continuo ed elevato rendimento di produzione in stretto coordinamento con i progettisti di fabbrica e il responsabile della produzione Responsabilità all'interno dello strato per la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività Documentazione delle prestazioni a turni e del passaggio ai successivi turni Supporto nella formazione dei nuovi dipendenti nel processo di produzione Identificazione, nonché l'integrazione di nuove tecnologie e migliori pratiche per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme al nostro team di ingegneria di processo Ridurre il comitato ad un minimo miglioramento e formazione Questo ti porta con formazione tecnica e formazione ulteriore (TS \/ HF) nel campo della tecnologia, della gestione o di un campo comparabile Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella produzione, idealmente nel funzionamento a turni Conoscenza del suono nella gestione della magra, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi Forte capacità di problem solving e approccio supportato dai dati nel processo decisionale
• Compiti con responsabilità personale Un team collegiale con brevi percorsi decisionali Condizioni di lavoro e opportunità di sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en:
In this responsible and dynamic role, you will be responsible for one shift of production at MICAFIL in Altstetten (ZH), ensuring that we continue to strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss subsidiary to meet global market growth. Through your clear communication and open personality, you continuously develop the teams and processes. With strategic foresight and technical know-how, you will support production team leaders and develop sustainable solutions that take quality, efficiency and competitiveness to the next level. If you have a passion for process optimization, we offer you the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our location. This can cause you to be responsible for a shift team in the production environment, including resource management and team development in a 3-shift operating model (direct management, 10-15 FTE) Ensuring a continuous and high production performance in close coordination with the factory planners and the production manager Responsibility within the layer for safety, quality and productivity Documentation of shift performance and handover to subsequent shifts Support in the training of new employees in the production process Identification as well as integration of new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with our process engineering team Reducing the committee to a minimum improvement and training of work & maintenance instructions to ensure the 3-shift operation Monitoring of the most important Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success measurement and feedback to the production manager This brings you with technical training and further education (TS \/ HF) in the field of technology, management or a comparable field Several years of professional experience in production, ideally in shift operation Sound knowledge in Lean management, Six Sigma and other methods of process optimization Strong problem-solving skills and data-supported approach in decision-making Strong skills in time management
• Tasks with personal responsibility A collegial team with short decision-making paths Attractive employment conditions and development opportunities
