jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)

Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist der Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochvoltdurchführungen für Transformatoren.
